name: cache-live-control
description: Change the prompt-cache TTL (5m, 1h or automatic) of one Claude Code chat with /cache: instantly, with no model turn, for the main chat, its sub-agents or both, and keep its background waits warm with visible pokes before the cache expires.

scripts.test: vitest run --dir tests && npm run test:hooks
scripts.test:hooks: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'NOT RUN: missing claude'; exit 3; }; claude plugin test plugins/cache-live-control && scripts/test-hook-variants.sh
scripts.validate:plugin: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'NOT RUN: missing claude'; exit 3; }; claude plugin validate --strict plugins/cache-live-control
